Messages.Author: Rafid Armani
Messages.Body:
1- Is Brujah Debate cummulative ?

2a- With Ancient Influence, do each methuselahs have to burn 5 pool,
even if they don't have a vampire in play ?

2b- If I have only a vampire of 3 cap, do I lose 2 pool ?

3- Genevieve has an additionnal vote for each political action. Does
it mean that she has 2 votes in the prisci vote and 1 vote in the main
referendum ?

4a- Does Entombment works at long range ?

4b- And Coma ?

5a- Can I redraw to my normal hand size before playing a Voter
Captivation ?

5b- And Cryptic Rider ?

Thanks for your time,

Rafid

Messages.Author: Sorrow
Messages.Body:
> 1- Is Brujah Debate cummulative ?

Yes.

> 2a- With Ancient Influence, do each methuselahs have to burn 5 pool,
> even if they don't have a vampire in play ?

I believe so. I think the gaining and losing of pool are mutually
exclusive.

> 2b- If I have only a vampire of 3 cap, do I lose 2 pool ?

That would be your net. +3 - 5 = -2

> 3- Genevieve has an additionnal vote for each political action. Does
> it mean that she has 2 votes in the prisci vote and 1 vote in the main
> referendum ?

No. 1 vote for the Prisci subvote and 1 regular vote. So she could
vote "No" for the Prisci subvote (determining how the 3 Prisci votes
will be cast) and "Yes" during regular voting, for example.

> 4a- Does Entombment works at long range ?

No. No strike cards work at long range unless stated otherwise in
the card text.

> 4b- And Coma ?

No, see above.

> 5a- Can I redraw to my normal hand size before playing a Voter
> Captivation ?

Yes because it is after the referrendum phase of the Political Action.

> 5b- And Cryptic Rider ?

Yes, see above.

> Thanks for your time,

NP, though, IANLSJ.

Sorrow

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On Tue, 7 Nov 2000, Rafid Armani wrote:

> 1- Is Brujah Debate cummulative ?

Yes.

> 2a- With Ancient Influence, do each methuselahs have to burn 5 pool,
> even if they don't have a vampire in play ?

Yes.

> 2b- If I have only a vampire of 3 cap, do I lose 2 pool ?

Yes. (You gain 3 then burn 5, net loss of 2.)

> 3- Genevieve has an additionnal vote for each political action. Does
> it mean that she has 2 votes in the prisci vote and 1 vote in the main
> referendum ?

1 prisci vote, 1 main referendum vote.

Any votes usable in the priscus vote have to say in large flashing neon
letters (or equivalent thereof) "in the Prisci vote".

> 4a- Does Entombment works at long range ?
>

No. All strikes work at close range unless otherwise stated.

> 4b- And Coma ?

No, as per 4a.

> 5a- Can I redraw to my normal hand size before playing a Voter
> Captivation ?

> 5b- And Cryptic Rider ?

Actually, I can find no mention in the new Rules Book regarding not
replacing any cards during a political action. (You could always replace
the card you used to call it, whilst your were still seeing if you were
being blocked, but other cards thrown down during the referendum couldn't
be replaced.)

Potentially, it was dropped because with the limitation to 1 political
action card for a vote per Methuselah, the potential for abuse of
replacing is greatly lessened. I don't recall, however, seeing it
mentioned as over-turned by the Rules Team.

Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <fNYN5.15594$mC.9...@monger.newsread.com>,
Sorrow <cbo...@apdi.net> wrote:

>> 2a- With Ancient Influence, do each methuselahs have to burn 5 pool,
>> even if they don't have a vampire in play ?
>

>I believe so. I think the gaining and losing of pool are mutually
>exclusive.

<PEDANT>

You mean 'independent,' not 'mutually exclusive.' If the events
were mutually exclusive, only one of the pair would happen, but
that is not the case with AInf. The pool gain event and the pool
loss event are independent -- it doesn't matter to one what the
status of the other is.

</PEDANT>

But we know that's what you meant.

gomi
